label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2). Within GO it is gated by the previous trial being unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 90% of mass; the top quartile is 99% covered) and by episode time: rate is about 20% in trials 0-9, falls steadily, and is essentially zero after trial ~60. That suggests a slowly drifting hidden-state component rather than a task variable. It has higher activation when the agent picks a2 (60% of mass) and with confident policy logits. The strongest activations come in early runs of consecutive unrewarded trials. The recorded predicate uses only observed variables (the previous reward and the trial index). Its precision is limited (many early unrewarded GO steps stay silent) and it misses the weak activations after rewarded trials very early in the episode. Adding ep_trial<10 to catch those raises dev F1 only from 0.68 to 0.69. Dev: P 0.63, R 0.74, F1 0.68, mass recall 0.88.
